notes: An initial ad-hoc verifier incorrectly sliced the constant signature to 33 bytes. The exact constant is 34 bytes; corrected before asserting correspondence.
Q resource verification compares both bounded raw copies; it does not invoke the FX-only END parser.
A checker error after it starts is incomplete_check, not a frontend rejection. Saved bytes can match even when checking fails.
Match fields are null when no corresponding saved payloads or exports exist; no empty-set success claim.
A captured backend rejection can coexist with an incomplete public check when diagnostic projection fails. Neither means acceptance or that all project resources were checked.
